Kill [[Joh the Hostile]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
Must have access to [[Lion's Arch Keep]], see [[:File:War in Kryta flow chart.png|flowchart]] for details.

===Objectives===
* Kill [[Joh the Hostile|Joh the Hostile]] in [[Scoundrel's Rise (War in Kryta)|Scoundrel's Rise]]
* *BONUS* Kill Joh the Hostile in [[Hard Mode]]
* See [[Princess Salma]] for your reward

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 3 [[War Supplies]]
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 1 War Supplies

==Walkthrough==
Starting from [[Gates of Kryta (outpost)|Gates of Kryta]] head north through the various Mergoyles. Head west along the sands and you can immediately see Joh the Hostile straight ahead. Kill him to complete the quest, and return to Princess Salma for your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Wanted by the Shining Blade
:''"[[Joh the Hostile]]'s enormous girth and sudden flurries of violence are not nearly as disturbing as his twisted mind. Joh is often heard singing eerily tranquil, repetitive tunes while tearing his victims limb from limb. He often sinks into a blind, adrenaline-fueled rage without warning. Joh the Hostile was last seen assisting [[Inquisitor Bauer]] with a mission of grave urgency. Queen Salma is offering a hefty bounty for any fearless souls who dare to slay this hulking butcher!"''
;After completion of The Battle for Lion's Arch
:''"Relive this historical event from the War in Kryta! [[Joh the Hostile]]'s enormous girth and sudden flurries of violence were not nearly as disturbing as his twisted mind. During the reign of the White Mantle zealots, Joh was often heard singing eerily tranquil, repetitive tunes while tearing his victims limb from limb. During the war, Joh the Hostile was killed while assisting [[Inquisitor Bauer]] on a mission of grave urgency. Earn a hefty bounty by re-creating the quest to slay this hulking butcher!"''
